newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Nestle sees 1996 profit over 3.0 bln Sfrs.
newsitem.headline: Nestle sees 1996 profit over 3.0 bln Sfrs.

text.p: Nestle SA said it expected its 1996 net profit to be higher than 3.0 billion Swiss francs.
In a news briefing to present 10-month results, Nestle also said that it expected its sales revenue for the entire year to be around 60 billion francs.

"Unless there is a very volatile turn-around in the currency market, we can expect net profits to grow faster than sales. In absolute terms they will certainly exceed 3.0 billion," said Nestle chairman Helmut Maucher.

Maucher, speaking during a news briefing said: "We are expecting to finish the year with turnover of close to 60 billion (Swiss francs) unless unexpectedly volatile currency fluctuations take place in the meantime."
Maucher said he was optimistic about growth continuing in the coming years, but provided no figures.
"I am an optimist as to continued growth in trade and net consolidated profit for next year as well as for the years to come," Maucher said. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
